name: Emanation (Shame)
scaffolding_intent: Emits steam particles around an entity and shifts its tint toward red: on an object, that it is hot; on a character, that they are embarrassed or ashamed

parameters.name: tint
parameters.description: RGB tint shift applied to entity pixels (additive)

parameters.name: tintSaturation
parameters.description: How strongly the tint is applied (0 = no tint, 1 = full tint)

correction_intent: Child described as cold or cool an object the scene shows hot (steam or heat rising from a pot, cup, iron, stove), or attributed a wrong emotion to a character the scene shows embarrassed or ashamed (blushing, hiding the face, looking down after a blunder). Target that object or character. Not for cold; that is P2b.
suggestion_intent: An object is visibly hot (steam, heat haze) or a character is visibly embarrassed or ashamed (blushing, hiding the face, looking down after a blunder), and the child mentioned it without saying so. Target that object or character. Requires a visible cue.
